response.text: Journal 1367 uses inactive account 5900, and invoice 801 has a negative amount whose journal is posted with the sign reversed. I have enough to submit.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=1368 GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: AP journal 1368 (period 3) is unbalanced: DR 9890.12 vs CR 9872.12, difference 18.00. Ties to invoice 222 whose INV_AMT is 9872.12, so the debit line is overstated by 18.00.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=2245 GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: AP journal 2245 (period 8) is unbalanced: DR 6631.24 vs CR 6622.24, difference 9.00. Invoice 757 INV_AMT is 6622.24, so the debit side is overstated by 9.00. Invoice 757 is paid at 6622.24.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS gl_cr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID"=743 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."CR_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 743 (open, INV_AMT 23078.91) is linked to journal 2221, which records 23051.91 on both sides. The GL posting is 27.00 less than the subledger amount. This is the same 27.00 as the overall journal imbalance gap, but it is a balanced entry that understates the payable.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS gl_dr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 222 (paid, INV_AMT 9872.12) ties to journal 1368 credit side but the debit side is 9890.12; subledger and GL disagree on the debit amount (see unbalanced journal 1368). Invoice 757 similarly has GL debit 6631.24 vs INV_AMT 6622.24. Both are included above as AP-to-GL mismatches on the expense/AP side.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT" < 0
findings.summary: Invoice 801 has a negative INV_AMT (-760.08) with status open. Its journal 2473 posts the amount as a positive debit to AP (2000) and credit to expense 5500, i.e. the reverse of a normal invoice. The sign is inconsistent with the invoice header and with the 'amounts are unsigned' convention; it looks like a credit memo keyed as an invoice, or a sign error.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") AS acct FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
findings.summary: Journal 1367 (AP, period 10) posts 7297.51 to account 5900, which is inactive (ACTV_FLG = N) in GLCOA. Posting to an inactive account is not permitted.
